versos.grego: Ἰησοῦς δὲ πλήρης Πνεύματος Ἁγίου ὑπέστρεψεν ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, καὶ ἤγετο ἐν τῷ Πνεύματι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

controles.web: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
controles.kjv: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
controles.livre: E Jesus, cheio do Espírito Santo, voltou do Jordão, e foi levado pelo Espírito no deserto.

versos.grego: ἡμέρας τεσσεράκοντα πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου. Καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγεν οὐδὲν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις, καὶ συντελεσθεισῶν αὐτῶν ἐπείνασεν.

controles.web: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.
controles.kjv: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
controles.livre: E por quarenta dias foi tentado pelo diabo; e não comeu coisa alguma naqueles dias; e terminados eles, teve fome.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ διάβολος Εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ, εἰπὲ τῷ λίθῳ τούτῳ ἵνα γένηται ἄρτος.

controles.web: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”
controles.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
controles.livre: Então o diabo lhe disse: Se tu és Filho de Deus, diz a esta pedra que se transforme em pão.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Γέγραπται ὅτι Οὐκ ἐπ’ ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος.

controles.web: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
controles.livre: Jesus lhe respondeu: Está escrito que não só de pão viverá o ser humano.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἀναγαγὼν αὐτὸν ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τῆς οἰκουμένης ἐν στιγμῇ χρόνου.

controles.web: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
controles.kjv: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
controles.livre: E o diabo o levou a um lugar alto, e lhe mostrou todos os reinos do mundo num instante.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ διάβολος Σοὶ δώσω τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην ἅπασαν καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἐμοὶ παραδέδοται καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν θέλω δίδωμι αὐτήν·

controles.web: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I give it to whomever I want.
controles.kjv: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
controles.livre: E o diabo lhe disse: Darei a ti todo este poder e sua glória; pois a mim foram entregues, e os dou a quem quero.

versos.grego: σὺ οὖν ἐὰν προσκυνήσῃς ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ, ἔσται σοῦ πᾶσα.

controles.web: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”
controles.kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
controles.livre: Portanto, se tu me adorares, tudo será teu.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Γέγραπται Προσκυνήσεις Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου καὶ αὐτῷ μόνῳ λατρεύσεις.

controles.web: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhe respondeu: Está escrito:  Adorarás ao Senhor teu Deus, e servirás só a ele.

versos.grego: Ἤγαγεν δὲ αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἔστησεν ἐπὶ τὸ πτερύγιον τοῦ ἱεροῦ, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ, βάλε σεαυτὸν ἐντεῦθεν κάτω·

controles.web: He led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,
controles.kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
controles.livre: Então o levou a Jerusalém, e o pôs sobre a parte mais alta do templo, e disse-lhe: Se tu és Filho  de Deus, lança-te daqui abaixo.

versos.grego: γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ τοῦ διαφυλάξαι σε,

controles.web: for it is written,  ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’
controles.kjv: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
controles.livre: Porque está escrito que: Mandará aos seus acerca de ti que te guardem.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅτι ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε μή ποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου.

controles.web: and,  ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”
controles.kjv: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
controles.livre: E que: te sustentarão pelas mãos, para que nunca tropeces com o teu pé em alguma pedra.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Εἴρηται Οὐκ ἐκπειράσεις Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου.

controles.web: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
controles.livre: Jesus lhe respondeu: Dito está: Não tentes  ao Senhor teu Deus.

versos.grego: Καὶ συντελέσας πάντα πειρασμὸν ὁ διάβολος ἀπέστη ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἄχρι καιροῦ.

controles.web: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.
controles.kjv: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
controles.livre: E quando o diabo acabou toda a tentação, ausentou-se dele por algum tempo.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὑπέστρεψεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ Πνεύματος εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν· καὶ φήμη ἐξῆλθεν καθ’ ὅλης τῆς περιχώρου περὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
controles.kjv: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
controles.livre: Então Jesus, no poder do Espírito, voltou para a Galileia, e sua fama se espalhou por toda a região ao redor.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδίδασκεν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν, δοξαζόμενος ὑπὸ πάντων.

controles.web: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
controles.kjv: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
controles.livre: Ele ensinava em suas sinagogas, e era recebido com honra por todos.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ναζαρά, οὗ ἦν τεθραμμένος, καὶ εἰσῆλθεν κατὰ τὸ εἰωθὸς αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων εἰς τὴν συναγωγήν, καὶ ἀνέστη ἀναγνῶναι.

controles.web: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
controles.kjv: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
controles.livre: Ele veio a Nazaré, onde havia sido criado, e entrou, conforme o seu costume, num dia de Sábado, na sinagoga; e levantou-se para ler.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπεδόθη αὐτῷ βιβλίον τοῦ προφήτου Ἡσαΐου, καὶ ἀνοίξας τὸ βιβλίον εὗρεν τὸν τόπον οὗ ἦν γεγραμμένον

controles.web: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
controles.kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
controles.livre: Foi-lhe dado o livro do profeta Isaías; e quando abriu o livro, achou o lugar onde estava escrito:

versos.grego: Πνεῦμα Κυρίου ἐπ’ ἐμέ, οὗ εἵνεκεν ἔχρισέν με εὐαγγελίσασθαι πτωχοῖς, ἀπέσταλκέν με κηρῦξαι αἰχμαλώτοις ἄφεσιν καὶ τυφλοῖς ἀνάβλεψιν, ἀποστεῖλαι τεθραυσμένους ἐν ἀφέσει,

controles.web: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,
controles.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
controles.livre: O Espírito do Senhor está sobre mim, porque ele me ungiu para evangelizar os pobres, me enviou

versos.grego: κηρῦξαι ἐνιαυτὸν Κυρίου δεκτόν.

controles.web: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”
controles.kjv: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
controles.livre: para proclamar liberdade aos cativos e dar vista aos cegos, para enviar livres os oprimidos, para proclamar o ano agradável do Senhor.

versos.grego: καὶ πτύξας τὸ βιβλίον ἀποδοὺς τῷ ὑπηρέτῃ ἐκάθισεν· καὶ πάντων οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἦσαν ἀτενίζοντες αὐτῷ.

controles.web: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
controles.kjv: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
controles.livre: Ele fechou o livro, e devolveu-o ao assistente, e se sentou. Os olhos de todos na sinagoga estavam fixos nele.

versos.grego: ἤρξατο δὲ λέγειν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὅτι Σήμερον πεπλήρωται ἡ γραφὴ αὕτη ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν ὑμῶν.

controles.web: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
controles.kjv: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
controles.livre: Então ele começou a lhes dizer: Hoje esta escritura se cumpriu em vossos ouvidos.

versos.grego: καὶ πάντες ἐμαρτύρουν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ἐπὶ τοῖς λόγοις τῆς χάριτος τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔλεγον Οὐχὶ υἱός ἐστιν Ἰωσὴφ οὗτος;

controles.web: All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”
controles.kjv: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?
controles.livre: E todos davam testemunho dele, e se admiravam das palavras graciosas que saíam da sua boca; e diziam: Não é este o filho de José?

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Πάντως ἐρεῖτέ μοι τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην Ἰατρέ, θεράπευσον σεαυτόν· ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν γενόμενα εἰς τὴν Καφαρναοὺμ, ποίησον καὶ ὧδε ἐν τῇ πατρίδι σου.

controles.web: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this parable, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Sem dúvida me direis este provérbio: Médico, cura a ti mesmo; faz também aqui na tua terra natal todas as coisas que ouvimos terem sido feitas em Cafarnaum.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δέ Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς προφήτης δεκτός ἐστιν ἐν τῇ πατρίδι αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
controles.kjv: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
controles.livre: E disse: Em verdade vos digo que nenhum profeta é bem recebido na sua terra natal.

versos.grego: ἐπ’ ἀληθείας δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, πολλαὶ χῆραι ἦσαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἡλείου ἐν τῷ Ἰσραήλ, ὅτε ἐκλείσθη ὁ οὐρανὸς ἐπὶ ἔτη τρία καὶ μῆνας ἕξ, ὡς ἐγένετο λιμὸς μέγας ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν,

controles.web: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.
controles.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
controles.livre: Porém em verdade vos digo que hava muitas viúvas em Israel nos dias de Elias, quando o céu se fechou por três anos e seis meses, de modo que em todo o país houve grande fome.

versos.grego: καὶ πρὸς οὐδεμίαν αὐτῶν ἐπέμφθη Ἡλείας εἰ μὴ εἰς Σάρεπτα τῆς Σιδωνίας πρὸς γυναῖκα χήραν.

controles.web: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
controles.kjv: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
controles.livre: Mas a nenhuma delas Elias foi enviado, a não ser a uma mulher viúva de Sarepta de Sidom.

versos.grego: καὶ πολλοὶ λεπροὶ ἦσαν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ Ἑλισαίου τοῦ προφήτου, καὶ οὐδεὶς αὐτῶν ἐκαθαρίσθη εἰ μὴ Ναιμὰν ὁ Σύρος.

controles.web: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”
controles.kjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
controles.livre: E havia muitos leprosos em Israel no tempo do profeta Eliseu; mas nenhum deles foi limpo, a não ser Naamã, o sírio.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν πάντες θυμοῦ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἀκούοντες ταῦτα,

controles.web: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.
controles.kjv: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
controles.livre: E todos na sinagoga, quando ouviram essas coisas, encheram-se de ira.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀναστάντες ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως, καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἕως ὀφρύος τοῦ ὄρους ἐφ’ οὗ ἡ πόλις ᾠκοδόμητο αὐτῶν, ὥστε κατακρημνίσαι αὐτόν·

controles.web: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
controles.kjv: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
controles.livre: Então se levantaram, expulsaram-no da cidade, e o levaram até o topo do monte em que sua cidade era construída, para dali o lançarem abaixo.

versos.grego: αὐτὸς δὲ διελθὼν διὰ μέσου αὐτῶν ἐπορεύετο.

controles.web: But he, passing through their midst, went his way.
controles.kjv: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
controles.livre: Porém ele passou por meio deles, e se retirou.

versos.grego: Καὶ κατῆλθεν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ πόλιν τῆς Γαλιλαίας. καὶ ἦν διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς σάββασιν·

controles.web: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,
controles.kjv: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
controles.livre: Ele desceu a Cafarnaum, cidade de Galileia; e ali os ensinava nos sábados.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐν ἐξουσίᾳ ἦν ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
controles.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
controles.livre: E admiravam o seu ensino, pois a sua palavra era com autoridade.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἦν ἄνθρωπος ἔχων πνεῦμα δαιμονίου ἀκαθάρτου, καὶ ἀνέκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ

controles.web: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,
controles.kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
controles.livre: E estava na sinagoga um homem que tinha um espírito de um demônio imundo, e gritou com alta voz:

versos.grego: Ἔα, τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί, Ἰησοῦ Ναζαρηνέ; ἦλθες ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς; οἶδά σε τίς εἶ, ὁ Ἅγιος τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!”
controles.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
controles.livre: Ah, que temos contigo, Jesus Nazareno? Vieste para nos destruir? Sei quem és: o Santo de Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων Φιμώθητι καὶ ἔξελθε ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ. καὶ ῥίψαν αὐτὸν τὸ δαιμόνιον εἰς τὸ μέσον ἐξῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ μηδὲν βλάψαν αὐτόν.

controles.web: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent, and come out of him!”  When the demon had thrown him down in their midst, he came out of him, having done him no harm.
controles.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
controles.livre: E Jesus o repreendeu, dizendo: Cala-te, e, sai dele. E o demônio o derrubou no meio do povo , e saiu dele sem lhe fazer dano algum.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο θάμβος ἐπὶ πάντας, καὶ συνελάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους λέγοντες Τίς ὁ λόγος οὗτος, ὅτι ἐν ἐξουσίᾳ καὶ δυνάμει ἐπιτάσσει τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις πνεύμασιν καὶ ἐξέρχονται;

controles.web: Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
controles.kjv: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
controles.livre: E espanto veio sobre todos; e falavam entre si uns aos outros, dizendo: Que palavra é esta, que até aos espíritos imundos ele manda com autoridade e poder, e eles saem?

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο ἦχος περὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς πάντα τόπον τῆς περιχώρου.

controles.web: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.
controles.kjv: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
controles.livre: E sua fama era divulgada em todos os lugares em redor daquela região.

versos.grego: Ἀναστὰς δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος. πενθερὰ δὲ τοῦ Σίμωνος ἦν συνεχομένη πυρετῷ μεγάλῳ, καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν περὶ αὐτῆς.

controles.web: He rose up from the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him for her.
controles.kjv: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
controles.livre: Jesus levantou-se da sinagoga, e entrou na casa de Simão. A sogra de Simão estava doente de uma grande febre, e rogaram-lhe por ela.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπιστὰς ἐπάνω αὐτῆς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ πυρετῷ, καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτήν· παραχρῆμα δὲ ἀναστᾶσα διηκόνει αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: He stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.
controles.kjv: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
controles.livre: Ele se inclinou a ela, e repreendeu a febre, que a deixou. Ela imediatamente se levantou e começou a lhes servir.

versos.grego: Δύνοντος δὲ τοῦ ἡλίου ἅπαντες ὅσοι εἶχον ἀσθενοῦντας νόσοις ποικίλαις ἤγαγον αὐτοὺς πρὸς αὐτόν· ὁ δὲ ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ αὐτῶν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιτιθεὶς ἐθεράπευεν αὐτούς.

controles.web: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
controles.kjv: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
controles.livre: Quando o sol estava se pondo, troxeram-lhe todos os que estavam enfermos de varias doenças. Ele punha as mãos sobre cada um deles e os curava.

versos.grego: ἐξήρχετο δὲ καὶ δαιμόνια ἀπὸ πολλῶν, κραυγάζοντα καὶ λέγοντα ὅτι Σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ. καὶ ἐπιτιμῶν οὐκ εἴα αὐτὰ λαλεῖν, ὅτι ᾔδεισαν τὸν Χριστὸν αὐτὸν εἶναι.

controles.web: Demons also came out of many, crying out, and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
controles.kjv: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
controles.livre: E também de muitos saíam demônios, gritando, e dizendo: Tu és o Filho de Deus. Ele os repreendia, e não os deixava falar, porque sabiam que ele era o Cristo.

versos.grego: Γενομένης δὲ ἡμέρας ἐξελθὼν ἐπορεύθη εἰς ἔρημον τόπον· καὶ οἱ ὄχλοι ἐπεζήτουν αὐτόν, καὶ ἦλθον ἕως αὐτοῦ, καὶ κατεῖχον αὐτὸν τοῦ μὴ πορεύεσθαι ἀπ’ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place, and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.
controles.kjv: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
controles.livre: E sendo já dia, ele saiu, e foi a um lugar deserto. As multidões o buscavam; então vieram a ele, e queriam detê-lo, para que não os deixasse.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὅτι Καὶ ταῖς ἑτέραις πόλεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαί με δεῖ τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὅτι ἐπὶ τοῦτο ἀπεστάλην.

controles.web: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of the Kingdom of God to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
controles.livre: Porém ele lhes disse: Também é necessário que eu anuncie a outras cidades o evangelho do Reino de Deus; pois para isso fui enviado.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς τῆς Ἰουδαίας.

controles.web: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
controles.kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
controles.livre: E ele pregava nas sinagogas da Judeia.
